Class FitVectors

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.splot.pdata.FitVectors
Direct Known Subclasses:
HistoFitPrep.FitWindowData
public class FitVectors extends Object
Immutable fit vectors (x, y, optional weights) used by the Apache least-squares fitters.

Weights are derived from the Y-error column e using w = 1/(e^2). If an error value is non-finite or <= 0, the corresponding weight is set to 0, which effectively removes that point from a weighted fit.

Important: This class validates that X and Y have the same length, and if an error column is provided, that it matches Y length as well.

    • testData

      public static FitVectors testData(Evaluator evaluator, double xStart, double xEnd, int nPoints, double jitterPercent, double sigmaYPercent)
      Generate test data (with randomness)for fitting.
      Parameters:
      evaluator - the evaluator to generate y values
      xStart - starting x value
      xEnd - ending x value
      nPoints - number of points evenly spaced between xStart and xEnd
      jitterPercent - percentage jitter to apply to y values. The jitter is computed as a random percentage [0, jitterPercentage] of the y value.
      sigmaYPercent - percentage of the signal scale to use as sigmaY. The sigmaY is computed as a random percentage [0, sigmaYPercent] of |yTrue| (falling back to a scale of 1.0 when yTrue is zero or non-finite, to avoid a degenerate sigma of 0).
      Returns:
      the fit vectors, with weights derived from sigmaY by w = 1/(sigmaY^2)
